title: ctenitis ferruginea
intro: Ctenitis ferruginea, commonly known as the rusty fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues, thanks to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties. The therapeutic actions of Ctenitis ferruginea are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, that may help to reduce inflammation, modulate the immune system, and exhibit antioxidant activity. Further research is needed to fully understand the effects of Ctenitis ferruginea on human health, but its traditional use in folk medicine suggests its potential as a natural remedy.
